NEOW.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BRUI: The voice that brought me here... Was it yours?
[sine]At the top... awaits the exit... and its guardian...[/sine]
[sine]... I merely... healed your wounds... how did you... endure...[/sine]
Heh heh... I'm a tough gal!
[sine]... accept my blessing... and climb anew....[/sine]
[sine]... traveler... your world awaits you... defeat the Architect...[/sine]
('ppreciate the blessings, but I don't think I can trust that thing.)
[sine]your power grew... this time... you might defeat him....[/sine]
Hope that doesn't mean I don't get to have a blessing this time?
(Wonder how the folks back home are doing?)
(I should also probably pay another visit to my other self's world soon... It's been a bit.)
Oh, crap! The teach's totally gonna bust my balls for not giving news! I've [jitter]GOTTA[/jitter] get out this time!
Can't let this get to me...
[sine]weary, but not discouraged, I see... good...[/sine]
OROBAS.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BR: Human?! From another world?! Which one?
My world's connected to all sorts of other places. One of the portals there took me here!
Collected new shiny for you!! Wear and match with me!!
Oh, it's you! Happy to see ya.
Weird human not friend with others?? Too shy?!
Nah, I just don't think I can trust anyone here. Except you, I mean. You're, uh... as simple as me.
Very simple, yes!! But not as much as you!!!
Too angry!! Friend should calm down!
Friend! You an Ironclad? Where armor? Where sword?!
Iron-what? No, no, I'm just... me. Good ol' boring me.
... Are you sure? Not Ironclad? Not even a little?!
I wonder where this little guy comes from?
I'm about done with this entire place... I should just wreck it all...
No! Not destroy!! I live here!!
PAEL.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BRUI: [thinky_dots]Such a curious soul, you are. You burn bright, and cast such a tall shadow.[/thinky_dots]
Continue
Come closer. Let me ascertain your nature.
Maybe a stupid question, but... are you okay?
Continue
[thinky_dots]Fear not. I give myself away for I cannot end as easily as you.[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Your eyes always shine when you gaze upon me. Do you admire dragons so?[/thinky_dots]
Deny
I-it's not anything like that! I just... am curious about you, I guess.
Continue
[thinky_dots]You need not deceive. I cast no judgement on you for it.[/thinky_dots]
'Whatever...'
[thinky_dots]Come, then. Accept my flesh, and perhaps it will bring your draconic potential out.[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Rest your weary wings with me, for a spell...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]I had a dream about your friend in red and white.[/thinky_dots]
Ask
Oh? Which one?
Continue
[thinky_dots]The angry one...[/thinky_dots]
Ask
... Which one?!
[thinky_dots]Pride... Power... Is it all worth it to you?[/thinky_dots]
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE: Oh, dear! Another human warrior attempting to achieve glory?
Nah, just trying to get home.
Oh? Well, then, let's see what old Tezcatara can do to help you out.
Ahh, the inner fire of a Berserker. [jitter][b]Enthralling.[/b][/jitter]
Oh, Shion, dearie... What will take it for you to accept [jitter][b]burning your weakness[/b][/jitter] away?
[jitter][b]Kakaka![/b][/jitter] It's a matter of when, dearie, not if!
I so wish to be here to see it happen, but if it isn't meant to be, let me at least assist you some more.
Don't try to look so serious, dearie. It's a silly look on you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE: What a brutish looking urchin you are...
Talk no more. Come forth, and let me refine you.
A gift, for a hard-at-work warrior. May it suit you well.
It's not much, and it's probably not standing up to your standards, but I thought it proper to thank you for your aid.
How quaint. My other champions have never reciprocated my gifts.
I shall accept it, child. Let me return the favour once more.
Mind you share another tale of your world?
TANX.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BRUI: Dunno if it counts, but technically, my fists are my weapons.
INCREDIBLE!! BUT YOU COULD HAVE [jitter][b]MORE[/b][/jitter] WEAPONS!!!
HAVE A WEAPON!! BUT IF YOU PICK DAGGERS, I WILL BE DISAPPOINTED!!!!
[i][font_size=22]Shion completely loses herself in her fight with Tanx.[/font_size][/i]
FREAKY BERSERKER?! GET A WEAPON AND GET OUT!!!
YOU!!! NOT NEARLY ANGRY ENOUGH!! GET ANGRIER, BERSERKER!!
VAKUU.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BRU: Hungry for power, are we? I think we can help each other out.
Have you any idea how many have said the exact same thing to me before you?
You remind me of one of my puppets. So furious. So determined. So... [jitter][b]frightened[/b][/jitter].
Damn. Finally gave up on the corrupting me thing? Thought I'd reach the top before THAT happened.
Hmph. Flaunt all you want. I should have checked whether another had laid claim on you before anything else.
What? Don't tell me when you haven't noticed.
Here's a fair deal, kid: take my blessing, and in exchange, when you see [b]HER[/b] again, tell her to keep her strays to herself.
[i][font_size=22]A boon is gifted and received in complete silence.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BRUI: Kindaaaa? I just trade junk from other worlds in the ones I visit to make some local penny.
Oh, heck yeah! I like ya' style! Let's trade!
Check out my newest finds, pal!
... and that one is a trap; if you break it, you take damage.
That's nasty! But I'll say, storing junk in them big screens seems handy!
It can be. Want some? Got quite a few to spare, really...
Y'know what? Whatever. Help y'self out to some of my junk, and I'll rid you of yours!
Oh! Oh!! I wanna test that one out, please!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION: So, I'm assuming you're the one that whale's warned me about.
How did an idiot like you climb to the top?
Yeah, sorry, I don't die easy.
My creation must truly be lacking for someone as weak as you to have survived it.
Still unable to get rid of me?
Don't we both have better things to do?
Yeah. That's why I'll beat you up good, and get outta here.
NEOW.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_ENDLE: Ah. I slipped on the wrong door. Happens even to the worst adventurer.
[sine].......did you... even leave.... I could have sworn....[/sine]
Wow I feel super refreshed! Thank you big whale!
I am positively and one hundred percently lost. Was this the kitchen?
DARV.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_ENDLE: And you're telling me you can store an infinite amount of trash?
Go on then! The first one is on me!
You can mimic things you absorb?
I don't have to absorb them but it's much better when I do, yes.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_: You look much cleaner than the average slime…
Let's refine your taste to be more akin to victory.
My goodness did that drop of water talk?
My goodness did it just [i]eat[/i] my blessing?
Is this protrusion on your head…
…an adorable little hat! What a cute creature.
OROBAS.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_END: Look! Pretty colors! You try being like this one!
Let's play Hide and Seek! You hide! I seek!
Found you! And this also. For you!!
PAEL.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_ENDLE: Are you a part of me?
No! My parts disappear when they are cut off.
Don't forget to rest, little slime. Even you need some sleep.
Do you know where you are going little slime?
Not a clue! That's usually how I get to my destination. Sheer luck!
This time you'll need more than luck.
TANX.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_ENDLE: Yeah it is kinda my thing.
Sorry I am lethally allergic to sharpness.
STRIKE ME! WITH ALL YOUR MIGHT!
[i][font_size=22]The Goofball throws itself at Tanx. It has no effect.[/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_: Looks like my soup is getting away again…
It lacks a very special ingredient…
What an adorable little slime. How should we reignite your violence?
Come on, just hop in my cauldron, there is a gift for you inside…
VAKUU.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_ENDL: Do you find it ironic your fellow slimes want you dead?
Interesting. You, of all creatures, seeks a contract with me?
You write fanfictions too?! Look! I wrote one where-
No deal. Take this and leave.
You can be anything, but I can make you someone.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_: Wow! Did you build that place? Are you a real architect?
What are you working on? Does it work on squirrels?
And you are supposed to be?…
Not a squirrel! I mean, most of the time! You see…
High mister! Is this the top? Is this where the whipped cream is?
Who brought some Overgrowth trash to my office?
I am trash but not from the Overgrowth! The truth is,…
Ah. Mister Architect. Have you considered installing an elevator?
And get more visits from the Underdocks? Pass.
There are many other advantages! Like…
Phew! What a wild ride! So, mister Architect, I have a message from Neow!
NEOW.party.SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_BRU: Oooh, a proper warrior, eh? Any pointers for an up-and-coming?
[i][font_size=22]The Ironclad gives a glare to Shion, but stays silent.[/font_size][/i]
Great. Good talk.
(Bunch o' weirdoes around here.)
*SNEEZE!*
... That works on myself?!
(The stench of bloodlust is impossible to miss off this guy...)
I've been meaning to ask... Can I get a swing off this thing?
(grunt)
Thanks, pal. Promise I'll be fast.
[i][font_size=22]Shion steadies herself and takes a grand swing before giving the Ironclad his sword back.[/font_size][/i]
Good stuff! Guessin' you made a lot of things bleed out with that one.
[jitter]... Is it because the sword keeps telling you to?![/jitter]
(I guess that's what happens when you let "it" win you over, huh.)
[red][sine]Heheh... Heh heh....[/sine][/red]
[red]KILL.... ENEMY.....[/red]
[red][sine]Oh, what a joy it is to be in good company![/sine][/red]
(He keeps looking towards the top of the Spire... but not the highest chamber?)
Oh, uh, hey! Wanna party up? I can take the aggro' off you.
(The Silent nods cautiously.)
Finally! Someone quiet and normal...
(I guess she lets the daggers do the talking.)
I've been meaning to ask... Can I get a swing off these things?
(nods)
Thanks, friend!
[i][font_size=22]Shion awkwardly holds the daggers.[/font_size][/i]
[i][font_size=22]The Silent sighs and adjusts Shion's grip.[/font_size][/i]
OH! That makes way more sense.
This place is almost peaceful.... Almost.
(She doesn't remember... So maybe...)
Say. Could I... If it's no p-problem... A dagger...
[i][font_size=22](The Silent throws a dagger Shion's way.)[/font_size][/i]
YAY!!
(cough) I mean, thanks. I, uh, want to get better at wielding weapons, see.
(nods)
(I want to talk to her more... But Neow's gaze is piercing...)
So, uh. I wanted to tell you.
I mean, uh. About the whole ascending the Spire, thing, we...
Just! Look at this, okay!
[i][font_size=22](The Silent looks at the dagger Shion holds, looking away.)[/font_size][/i]
[i][font_size=22](The Silent gives Shion's head a quick pat.)[/font_size][/i]
OAZJDIOAZJDIAZJDIOZSZHJAFZDC????
[i][font_size=22]Before their ascent, Shion and the Silent wrap in their respective clothes.[/font_size][/i]
Can I help you, siiir...? Maybe?
(inquisitive beep)
Hm? Are you worrying about me?
(affirmative beep)
Haha, don't worry! I'm used to getting the lights knocked out of me.
(increasingly worried beeps)
Hm... Wonder if we can communicate any other way?
Hello! Hear ya loud and clear!
Haha, indeed!
(impressed beep)
Yes, she really is awesome!
Poor Abby. I miss her so much...
What, here?
I wanted to leave ASAP, but I can't just not help a fella trying to find his friend...
Well, hello, party people! Ready to make some noise?
Kill.... Maim....
This day is going to be long.... So very long...
(Being with adept teammates? Great. But the vibe here? Awful.)
Halt. What do you want?
Help to defeat the man atop of this bloody tower.
Fine. But I want the final blow.
Suit yourself! Er, selves?
Oh! Your friend bumped into me.
Osty is greeting you.
Oh!! Well, shucks, hi Osty!
[i][font_size=22]Shion shakes Osty's finger with her hand.[/font_size][/i]
I feel extremely silly...
What a strange, strange girl...
You should treat your body better.
Meh. It will serve its purpose or expire trying. My problem, mind, not yours.
Heed my warning, or don't. It does not trouble me.
It shouldn't! It shouldn't...
[i][font_size=22](Shion takes a nap on top of Osty.)[/font_size][/i]
I can't make sense out of you.
Heh heh. You're overthinking it. I'm just a gal trying her best!
If that's what you wanna tell yourself...
Hm mh!
Tall girl! Take the blows for me!
For anyone else, sure... But when people ask it first, it's weird.
What? What difference does it make?
I dunno... it gives bad vibes...
Death tires me less than his monologues...
Who are these guys? Summons? Familiars, perhaps?
They're my loyal servants!
Oh. Servants. You're one of [i]those[/i], huh?
How dare you look at me with such disgust? I'm the future KING, you know?
[i][font_size=22](Shion gives a piggyback ride to the Regent, a dejected look on her face.)[/font_size][/i]
Servant! Clean the way, won't you?
(grumble) (grumble)....
Servant! Less complaining!
I'm calm. I'm normal. I'm upset in a calm, normal way.
Imagine if you had as many hands as he has minions.
One is enough. Osty will kill the Architect.
As if! I will gloriously strike them down and bring their head back home to decorate my throne room!
Well, well! Aren't we a happy crew.
(These two... kind of remind me of friends.)
Oh, hey! Glad to see ya. It's full of weirdos, here...
Just like old times, eh?
I'll show you just how hard I've been working!
Hi! What's your, uh... gimmick?
Your look... Have I seen you somewhere? No?
Once we're done, have you any trinkets from your world to trade? I'm something of a merchant, see!
Oh, uh... That's funny.
Promise not to be abnormally stronger than me and force me to go on a soul-searching journey across worlds?
Hah! Sure!
... Do we always dress this boring?
Heh heh. Nothing against a friendly competition, I wager?
